scope: Stopped guest network queue reconstruction, ARP exchange, detach and revocation; not guest recreation

spark.host: make test-host passed; 27 network admission and canonical-layout checks

intel.command: make gate-x86_64-teardown SEL4_SDK_VERSION=2.3.0 with retained checksummed OVMF, kernel and initrd
checks: Two generations receive fresh frame capabilities with canonical free queues
Each generation sends an ARP request to the QEMU gateway through net_virt and net_pd
Each reply has ARP response opcode, gateway sender IP, guest target IP and guest destination/target MAC
TX buffer is returned, then detach closes the raw session and retires queues
Pool revocation removes the returned frame capability, verified by failed lookup
Existing block, serial, memory, execution and lifecycle proofs also pass

limitations: Native malformed-capability and allocation-failure cases remain incomplete
VMM device-state adoption/reset and firmware reset are not wired into CREATE
No second guest boot or complete v0.4 release acceptance is claimed
